description:
Close REQ-08's compile-time-constant clause for the one well-known repository path that still reaches production as a runtime string, and make the known-path inventory structurally self-enforcing rather than hand-maintained.

## Background

The independent `holistic-review` gate on epic `1cc809de` failed with one blocking finding against `@/issue/1cc809de/success_criteria/REQ-08`:

> REQ-08 is not fully met: the fixed `.jit/config/gate-presets` path remains repeatedly constructed from runtime strings (for example `crates/jit/src/commands/gate.rs:246`), while `VirtualPath::ALL_KNOWN` (`crates/jit/src/repository_state/path.rs:237`) is a hand-maintained mirror that cannot enforce complete coverage. This contradicts the criterion that well-known repository paths are compile-time constants.

Both halves were recorded as deferred follow-ups during wave 6 on the reasoning that the approved plan enumerated the const set. That reasoning does not make the criterion met: REQ-08 says well-known repository file paths are compile-time constants, and `config/gate-presets` is one.

`ALL_KNOWN`'s own doc comment states the defect: "Adding a new const without listing it here leaves it unproven." That is the same hand-maintained-mirror class REQ-08 already fixed for repair-target coverage by deriving it from the repair planner's declaration, left standing in the very type wave 5 introduced.

## Production sites

`config/gate-presets` reaches production as a runtime string at:

- `crates/jit/src/commands/gate.rs:246` — `VirtualPath::data("config/gate-presets")?`
- `crates/jit/src/commands/gate.rs:255` — `format!("config/gate-presets/{name}")`
- `crates/jit/src/commands/gate.rs:284` — `"config/gate-presets".to_string()`
- `crates/jit/src/commands/gate.rs:301` — `VirtualPath::data("config/gate-presets")?`
- `crates/jit/src/commands/gate.rs:337` — `format!("config/gate-presets/{name}.json")`
- `crates/jit/src/repository_state/mutation.rs:991` — the same prefix rebuilt via `format!`

Verify this inventory yourself with `git grep -n "config/gate-presets" -- crates/jit/src`; treat the list above as a starting point, not an authority, and migrate every production site it finds. Test-only occurrences may keep literals where that is clearer, but they must not be the reason a production site keeps one.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The `config/gate-presets` directory is a compile-time `VirtualPath` associated const, and no production code path constructs that directory from a runtime string literal.
- [hard] REQ-02: Paths beneath that directory derive from the const rather than re-spelling the prefix in a `format!` string.
- [hard] REQ-03: The well-known-path inventory and the associated consts originate from a single declaration, so adding a const without adding it to the inventory is impossible at compile time rather than merely untested. `ALL_KNOWN`'s doc comment no longer describes a coverage gap, because none exists.
- [hard] REQ-04: The existing round-trip proof over the inventory still holds, and every well-known const is proven canonical and non-reserved through the fallible constructor.

## Non-goals

- A general `join`/`child` composite-path API for `VirtualPath` is out of scope; ~78 composite sites keep the fallible constructor. Add only what these criteria need.
- The `InMemoryStorage::issue_vpath` panic path (`storage/memory.rs:334,346`) is out of scope. The same holistic review classified it advisory and pre-existing; it is recorded as a follow-up.

## Notes

The enforcement mechanism must not be source-text matching. Wave 6 deliberately replaced a source-text-substring guard with visibility enforcement (`67a77503`), and a guard bound to a hand-written mirror of the thing it checks is circular. Bind the inventory to the declaration itself — a single macro or equivalent that emits both the consts and the inventory is the intended shape.

Cross-cutting: `@/inv/single-source-prose`, `@/inv/semantic-test-assertions`.
title: Make the gate-presets path a constant and the known-path inventory self-enforcing
